        public static URL locateResource(String resource)

      • loadPropertiesFile

        public static Properties loadPropertiesFile(String filename)
                                     throws JConfigurationException
        This method will attempt to take all the properties identified in the given file and load them as system properties. If the file cannot be open or read, or an error occurs during the process, a JConfigurationException will be thrown.
        Parameters:
        filename - The name of the properties file to load
        Throws:
        JConfigurationException

      • loadPropertiesFile

        public static Properties loadPropertiesFile(String filename,
                                            String prefix)
                                     throws JConfigurationException
        Load the specified properties file into a properties instance, prefixing all found properties with the given string. If the string is null or empty, no prefix will be added. If the prefix contains a value, it will be put on the front of each key, separated by a "." character. For example, the prefix of "portico" would cause "portico." to be prefixed to all keys found in the properties file. If the file cannot be open or read, or a general error occurs, a JConfigurationException will be thrown.
        Parameters:
        filename - The name of the properties file to load
        prefix - The prefix to apply to all properties found in the specified properties file
        Throws:
        JConfigurationException

      • loadPropertiesResource

        public static Properties loadPropertiesResource(String resource)
                                         throws JConfigurationException
        This method will attempt to take all the properties identified in the given resource and load them as system properties. If the resource cannot be open or read, or an error occurs during the process, a JConfigurationException will be thrown.

        NOTE: This differs from loadPropertiesFile(String) in that it will try to find the file as a system resource (located on the classpath and within jar/archives on the classpath) where the other method will only load a file that exists direclty on the filesystem.

        Parameters:
        resource - The name of the resource representing the properties to load
        Returns:
        The properties that were loaded
        Throws:
        JConfigurationException

      • loadPropertiesResource

        public static Properties loadPropertiesResource(String resource,
                                                String prefix)
                                         throws JConfigurationException
        Load the specified properties resource into a properties instance, prefixing all found properties with the given string. If the string is null or empty, no prefix will be added. If the prefix contains a value, it will be put on the front of each key, separated by a "." character. For example, the prefix of "portico" would cause "portico." to be prefixed to all keys found in the properties file. If the file cannot be open or read, JConfigurationException will be thrown. NOTE: This differs from loadPropertiesFile(String) in that it will try to find the file as a system resource (located on the classpath and within jar/archives on the classpath) where the other method will only load a file that exists direclty on the filesystem.
        Parameters:
        resource - The name of the resource representing the properties to load
        prefix - The prefix to apply to all properties found in the specified properties file
        Throws:
        JConfigurationException
